items.title: Compagnia del Gusto acquires wine delivery firm Winelivery
items.summary: Italian food-and-drinks group Compagnia del Gusto Holding has continued its buying spree with a deal for local wine delivery firm Winelivery.

items.title: Ninoush Habashian Appointed IT Director Of Coop Sweden
items.summary: Coop Sweden has named Ninoush Habashian as its new director of digital and IT, effective from February 2027.

items.title: Delhaize builds a new fresh produce warehouse and invests 120 million euros
items.summary: Delhaize is allocating 120 million euros to expand its logistics capacity in Belgium. Among other things, the supermarket chain is building a new distribution center for fresh products in Zellik. The investment is expected to create 130 new permanent jobs.

items.title: Barry Callebaut And Arla Foods To Cut Dairy Emissions In Chocolate Supply Chain
items.summary: Chocolate producer Barry Callebaut has entered a three-year dairy partnership with Arla Foods to reduce their climate emissions.

items.title: Greek Supermarket Prices Fall 0.15% In August - IELKA
items.summary: Greek supermarket prices during August registered an inflation rate of -0.15% compared to the same month last year, notes IELKA.

items.title: Six more stores for Bike Republic
items.summary: Bike Republic will expand from 42 to 48 locations in the coming months. The Colruyt Group’s bicycle chain is now deliberately targeting city centers and expects to return to profitability this year.

items.title: The Range rolls out VoCoVo headsets to all stores
items.summary: The Range has partnered with wireless services firm VoCoVo to roll out its headsets across all of its stores.

items.summary: John Lewis has unveiled an all year round content studio, ‘The Box Studio’, a new space for video and social content. The Box Studio is located inside the retailer’s Oxford Street Store. It believes that people want to see products demonstrated to them and content can help with…

items.title: Aldi to launch a new store every week in September
items.summary: Aldi is opening a new store every week during September, creating up to 120 new jobs across its four locations.

items.title: The Works upgrades profit outlook after sales soar
items.summary: The Works has upgraded its full-year profit outlook after like-for-like sales rose 10.4 per cent in the first 18 weeks of FY27.

items.title: Haleon Secures Better Shelf Space At Walmart, Target In Bid To Boost Market Share
items.summary: Haleon has quietly negotiated better spots on shelves at US retailers including Walmart and Target, to gain more visibility.
